
```{r}
data <- read.csv("D:/First Semester/Project Learning from Data/final data.txt", sep=";")

head(data)
print(data)
```

```{r}
group_number <- 4
rows_to_remove <- c(group_number * 11, group_number^2, 2 * group_number + 21)

print(rows_to_remove)


removed_rows <- data[-rows_to_remove, ]


print(head(removed_rows))
print(removed_rows)
```

```{r}
summary(removed_rows)
```

```{r}
na_positions <- is.na(removed_rows)

# Print the row and column indices where NAs are present
which(na_positions, arr.ind = TRUE)
```


```{r}
sum(rowSums(is.na(removed_rows)) > 0)
```


```{r}
data_clean <- na.omit(removed_rows)
print(data_clean)
```

```{r}
summary(data_clean)
```

```{r}
na_positions <- is.na(data_clean)

# Print the row and column indices where NAs are present
which(na_positions, arr.ind = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

create_qq_plot <- function(var, var_name) {
  ggplot(data_clean, aes(sample = var)) +
    stat_qq(size = 1.5, color = "blue") +           # Larger points and color for visibility
    stat_qq_line(color = "red", linewidth = 1) +    # Thicker reference line
    ggtitle(paste("Q-Q Plot for", var_name)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +                 # Base font size for clarity
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 16),  # Center and bold title
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 12)
    ) +
    labs(x = "Theoretical Quantiles", y = "Sample Quantiles")
}

# Create Q-Q plots for each independent variable
create_qq_plot(data_clean$Lutum, "Lutum")
create_qq_plot(data_clean$Silt, "Silt")
create_qq_plot(data_clean$Sand, "Sand")
create_qq_plot(data_clean$pH, "pH")

```

```{r}

# Reshape data to long format
data_long <- data_clean %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Lutum, Silt, Sand, pH), names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Value")

# Create a boxplot for all variables
ggplot(data_long, aes(x = Variable, y = Value, fill = Variable)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = 21, outlier.fill = "white", outlier.color = "black") +
  ggtitle("Boxplots of Independent Variables") +
  ylab("Values") +
  xlab("Variables") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 18, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "none"   # Remove legend as each boxplot is already labeled
  ) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set3") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Lutum", "Silt", "Sand", "pH"))  # Ensures readable labels


```

```{r}

```

```{r}
Q1 <- quantile(data_clean$Cstock, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
Q3 <- quantile(data_clean$Cstock, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
IQR_value <- Q3 - Q1

# Calculate lower and upper bounds for outliers
lower_bound <- Q1 - 1.5 * IQR_value
upper_bound <- Q3 + 1.5 * IQR_value

# Filter out outliers
data_clean <- subset(data_clean, Cstock >= lower_bound & Cstock <= upper_bound)

# Verify the data after outlier removal
print(head(data_clean))
print(data_clean)
```

```{r}
#we renamed of the spelling mistake of the region variable.
correct_names <- function(name) {
  if (name == "Keempen" || name == "Kempeen") {
    return("Kempen")
  } else if (name == "Leemstrek" || name == "Lemstreek") {
    return("Leemstreek")
  } else {
    return(name)
  }
}


# Apply the function to the Region column in data_clean
data_clean$Region <- sapply(data_clean$Region, correct_names)

```


```{r}
stats_by_region <- data_clean %>%
  group_by(Region) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Lutum = mean(Lutum, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_Lutum = sd(Lutum, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Sand = mean(Sand, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_Sand = sd(Sand, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Silt = mean(Silt, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_Silt = sd(Silt, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_pH = mean(pH, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_pH = sd(pH, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_Cstock = mean(Cstock, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_Cstock = sd(Cstock, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

print(stats_by_region)
```

```{r}
skewness_Lutum <- skewness(data_clean$Lutum, na.rm = TRUE)

cat("Skewness of Cstock:", skewness_Cstock, "\n")

```

```{r}
#We can see that Sand has negative correlation with other variables
model <- lm(Cstock ~ Crop + Lutum + Sand + Silt + pH + Years, data = data_clean)
summary(model)
```

```{r}
plot(model$fitted.values, resid(model), 
     xlab = "Fitted Values", 
     ylab = "Residuals", 
     main = "Residuals vs Fitted")
abline(h = 0, col = "red")

# Q-Q Plot for Checking Normality
qqnorm(resid(model))
qqline(resid(model), col = "red")
```

```{r}

# Compute the correlation matrix
cor_matrix <- cor(data_clean[, c("Lutum", "Silt", "Sand", "pH", "C", "Years", "Cstock")], use = "complete.obs")

corrplot(
  cor_matrix, 
  method = "circle",        
  type = "upper",           
  order = "hclust",         
  addCoef.col = "black",    
  tl.col = "black",         
  tl.srt = 45,              
  col = colorRampPalette(c("red", "white", "blue"))(200), 
  title = "Correlation Matrix of Variables", 
  mar = c(0, 0, 2, 0)      
)

```
```{r}
model1 <- lm(Cstock ~ Crop + Lutum + Silt + pH + Years, data = data_clean)
summary(model1)
```


